title: Puzzle 3d Workbench Drag Drop
description: Make object kinds from the workbench panel draggable and droppable into puzzle 3d at cursor intersection with the grid plane.
summary: Fixed declarative tree palette drag: (1) hoist tree-root panels via SidePanelTabConfig.panel + registerSidePanelBody mount treeRoot so kinds/hierarchy are a single Tree not nested in shell tree; (2) Tree draggable rows use select-none labels and cursor-grab so text selection no longer blocks HTML5 drag; (3) stopPropagation on tree dragstart. Extended ui SidePanel, playground/core mount registry.
